text.text_excerpt: We usually stay on magazine street (last 5-6 trips) so I was a little hesitant to stay here. But pleasantly surprised! The location was only a few minutes more to get to Canal St. Couple of good restaurants within block or two. We had a one bedroom suite--almost as big as our condo lol! Couple issues with housekeeping-we requested our linens to be changed twice (Monday thru Friday stay) and while the sheets appeared to be changed, the pillow cases were not changed either time. Also our room was not cleaned one day-we had to call the front desk around 5pm to get that taken care of. Complimentary breakfast and social hour we didn't take advantage of but nice perk. Before we stayed I read some super mixed reviews on here so I didn't really know what to expect. The hotel is just fine...it's not anything super fancy but it's not terrible either. The breakfast and snacks that they have are about the same, but it's really nice to have especially when you're trying to save a few dollars while traveling. The staff were all super friendly, including the valet guys who opened the hotel doors for us just about every time we walked up. It's about a 10-15 minute walk to just about everything so super convenient. I would definitley stay here again!

We booked our rooms here a couple of months before the pandemic. We thought about canceling since there was alot of concern, especially in New Orleans, right after Mardi Gras. Needless to say, we went and had a great time. This is a wonderful hotel. In the NOLA business district, ten minute walk to the French Quarter. We really enjoyed staying here. We were not in our room for long. Just to sleep basically. Very clean. All the amenities you need. Everyone was super nice. Free breakfast was just ok, but not bad. 4 stars for 35.00 a day parking charge.
